newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms ratings on 4 Japanese nonlife insurers.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms ratings on 4 Japanese nonlife insurers.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it had affirmed its ratings assigned to four Japanese nonlife insurance companies following a recent review of the industry.
The four companies are Dowa Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd, Mitsui Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd, Sumitomo Marine & Fire Insurance Co Ltd and Nippon Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd.

S&P said in a statement it viewed the Japanese nonlife insurance sector as stable over the near term, based on the industry's strong rebound in underwriting performance that began in the year from April 1, 1994, and extended through 1995/96, which it said should be sustainable over the near term in the absence of major catastrophes.
